short_description: Berlin-headquartered German pharmaceutical company, incorporated in 2021 as a joint venture of Berlin-based cannabinoid-therapeutics group Sanity Group and an international research team led by Prof. Dr. F. Markus Leweke and Dr. Cathrin Rohleder. Endosane develops next-generation drug candidates targeting the endocannabinoid system for neuropsychiatric and psychiatric indications including schizophrenia and post-traumatic stress disorder, and continued advanced-stage clinical work through Sanity Group's parent-company transition into Canadian cannabis operator Organigram Global in 2026.
